# LegalKnowledgeBase.com

> A comprehensive Q&A platform covering criminal law, tort law, civil law, legal education, and practice guidance across multiple jurisdictions.

LegalKnowledgeBase.com aggregates trending and popular legal questions with detailed guides on criminal law procedures, tort law principles, and law school preparation. The site serves both aspiring lawyers and those seeking legal knowledge across US states (Texas, California, Florida), India, Australia, and UK jurisdictions.

## Key Topics

- Criminal Law
- Tort Law
- Civil Law
- Legal Education
- LSAT
- LLB / Juris Doctor
- Bar Exam & Licensing
- Court Procedures
- Negligence
- Defamation
- Felony Classification
- Employment Law
- Public Interest Litigation (PIL)
- Texas & California Law
- Legal Careers

## Core Content & Discovery

- [LegalKnowledgeBase.com](https://legalknowledgebase.com): Homepage offering Q&A on business, criminal, family, employment, and immigration law
- [Trending questions](https://legalknowledgebase.com/trending): Trending legal questions covering First Amendment, court rules, and popular topics
- [Popular questions](https://legalknowledgebase.com/popular): Popular monthly legal Q&A on criminal law, constitutional law, and procedures

## Criminal Law & Felony Classification

- [What is second-degree felony?](https://legalknowledgebase.com/what-is-second-degree-felony): Guide to second-degree felony classification in Texas and Florida criminal law
- [What is a f3 felony in Texas?](https://legalknowledgebase.com/what-is-a-f3-felony-in-texas): Explanation of third-degree felony in Texas Penal Code with sentencing guidelines
- [What is not contempt of court?](https://legalknowledgebase.com/what-is-not-contempt-of-court): Explanation of contempt of court definition and civil vs criminal distinctions

## Tort Law & Negligence

- [What is the Caparo test?](https://legalknowledgebase.com/what-is-the-caparo-test): Reference on Caparo three-part test for negligence claims in English law
- [How do you prove causation in tort law?](https://legalknowledgebase.com/how-do-you-prove-causation-in-tort-law): Guide to proving causation in tort law using but-for test and proximate causation
- [What components are needed to prove negligence?](https://legalknowledgebase.com/what-components-are-needed-to-prove-negligence): Guide to five elements of negligence proof in tort law and personal injury cases
- [What is civil defamation?](https://legalknowledgebase.com/what-is-civil-defamation): Explanation of civil defamation, libel, slander under IPC Section 500
- [What are punitive damages in California?](https://legalknowledgebase.com/what-are-punitive-damages-in-california): Explanation of punitive damages under California Civil Code 3294 and malice standards

## Legal Education & Law School
